schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Kings River, Below Pine Flat Dam (Region 4, Fresno Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of January-December. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant; the document does not specify which of this record's lettered reaches below the dam this covers.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Kings River, Below Pine Flat Dam (Region 4, Fresno Co.) for sub-catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of January-December. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant; the document does not specify which of this record's lettered reaches below the dam this covers.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Kings River, Upper (Region 4, Fresno Co.) for fingerling-size Brown Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of June-September.
